SELECT 'SCHEDULE-' || S.SCHEDULE_NUM AS EVENT_ID, S.TITLE,
CASE WHEN S.ALL_DAY = 1 THEN TO_CHAR(S.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE TO_CHAR(S.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') END AS START_DATE,
CASE WHEN S.ALL_DAY = 1 THEN TO_CHAR(S.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE TO_CHAR(S.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') END AS END_DATE,
S.COLOR,
CASE WHEN S.ALL_DAY = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ALL_DAY_VALUE,
'SCHEDULE' AS EVENT_TYPE, S.SCHEDULE_NUM, S.TEAM_NUM, S.CATEGORY, S.CONTENT
FROM SCHEDULE S WHERE S.TEAM_NUM = #{team_num} AND S.STATUS = 1 ORDER BY S.START_DATE ASC

SELECT 'SCHEDULE-' || S.SCHEDULE_NUM AS EVENT_ID, S.TITLE,
CASE WHEN S.ALL_DAY = 1 THEN TO_CHAR(S.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE TO_CHAR(S.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') END AS START_DATE,
CASE WHEN S.ALL_DAY = 1 THEN TO_CHAR(S.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE TO_CHAR(S.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') END AS END_DATE,
S.COLOR,

SELECT 'KANBAN-' || KC.CARD_NUM AS EVENT_ID, KC.TITLE, TO_CHAR(KC.DEADLINE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS END_DATE, NVL(KC.TAG_COLOR, '#6C5CE7') AS COLOR, 1 AS ALL_DAY_VALUE, 'KANBAN' AS EVENT_TYPE, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS SCHEDULE_NUM, KC.CARD_NUM, KC.TEAM_NUM, KC.TAG AS CATEGORY, KC.CONTENT, KC.KANBAN_STATUS
FROM KANBAN_CARD KC WHERE KC.TEAM_NUM = #{team_num} AND KC.STATUS != 2 AND KC.DEADLINE IS NOT NULL AND KC.DEADLINE >= TO_DATE(#{start_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND KC.DEADLINE < TO_DATE(#{end_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TEAM_MEMBER TM WHERE TM.TEAM_NUM = KC.TEAM_NUM AND TM.USER_NUM = #{user_num} AND TM.JOIN_STATUS = 1 )
ORDER BY KC.DEADLINE ASC, KC.CARD_NUM DESC
